patterns.note: The initial hero section uses full-screen, horizontally-scrolling (or snapping) content blocks, each with a distinct background color, large image, and associated text, before transitioning to a vertically scrolling grid.

Dramatic typographic contrast is used, featuring a decorative gothic-style serif for the main logo, elegant condensed serifs for project titles, small uppercase sans-serifs for navigation and metadata, and very large, bold sans-serifs for prominent brand names.
The site uses a high-contrast palette of dark greys/blacks and light greys/pinks, punctuated by deep reds, with background colors dynamically changing per full-screen content block.

The initial hero section features a scroll-triggered horizontal content transition, where each full-screen slide (image, text, background color) snaps into view. After this, the page transitions to standard vertical scrolling, revealing a masonry-like grid and large text sections. The header (logo and navigation) remains sticky at the top.
Large, full-width text sections featuring brand names (e.g., FENTY, SWAROVSKI) are used as high-impact dividers or highlights within the portfolio grid.

technique_notes: The initial portfolio showcase is built as a series of full-screen content panels that horizontally scroll or snap into place, each panel dynamically updating the background color, a large hero image, and descriptive text. This creates a distinct visual break and focused presentation for each featured project.
The main navigation and site logo are implemented as a sticky header, ensuring they remain visible and accessible at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls through the content.

Subsequent portfolio items are displayed in a responsive, masonry-style grid layout that allows for varied image sizes and aspect ratios, creating a dynamic visual flow. This grid is interspersed with full-width, high-contrast text blocks that serve as bold section dividers or brand callouts.

design_tokens.type_scale: A dramatic scale with a decorative gothic logo, elegant serif headings (~2x body), small uppercase sans-serif labels (~0.8x body), and extremely large, bold sans-serif brand names (~5-8x body).
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in the initial full-screen hero sections, transitioning to a balanced density for the image grid, with generous negative space around large brand name sections.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the initial full-screen, horizontally-scrolling portfolio showcase, where each project is presented with a unique background color, large image, and text block, creating a highly immersive and dynamic introduction to their work. This is combined with the bold, high-contrast typographic treatment of brand names as section dividers.
